items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Happy used to play bass drum with him [Alvin Alcorn].

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, I remember when he was with Allen.

Well, Alvin Alcorn. That's in my town. He used to hire lots of other fellows like that to come play with him, like, uh, used to have, uh, Happy playing drum. Mm-hmm. And, uh... Which Happy? The Happy that studied. You know Happy that studied? Black Happy. Yeah, Black Happy. Gold. Well, Happy used to play bass drum with him. Yeah. And, uh, Old Man Allen had a brother by the name of George used to play the snare drum. Mm-hmm.
I don't know anything about him. Did he play in any dance band? Sit down and talk?
